title: overlap-is-not-identification: code for "Overlap Is Not Identification: Reactive Pricing, Exogenous Variation, and Double Machine Learning"
description:
Code, simulation output and paper source for Overlap Is Not Identification: Reactive Pricing, Exogenous Variation, and Double Machine Learning.

Includes overlap_diag, a Python package with a cross-fitted partially linear double machine learning estimator, the overlap-inflation diagnostic, and the tipping point with benchmarks, and the scripts that reproduce every number, table and figure in the paper. Simulations use synthetic data; the semi-synthetic studies use public New York City TLC trip records and DCWP delivery-app data with a simulated outcome.
